title: Bubble chart
description:
A bubble chart is a scatter plot with sizes: (`x_column`, `y_column`) per row, the
circle's area by `size_column`, groups by `color_column`, a text by `label_column`.
See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

query.sql:
SELECT company, revenue, margin, cap,
       CASE WHEN cap > 800 THEN 'Large' WHEN cap > 400 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'Small' END AS class
FROM (
  SELECT 'Apple' AS company, 80 AS revenue, 25 AS margin, 1400 AS cap
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Google', 70, 22, 1100 UNION ALL SELECT 'Tesla', 30, 35, 600
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Netflix', 20, 15, 250 UNION ALL SELECT 'Adobe', 25, 40, 300
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Meta', 50, 30, 700
)

show.title: size, color and label columns (canvas: braille)
show.description:
`size_column` sets each circle's area, `color_column` groups and colors the bubbles
(`colors` by name), `label_column` writes a text next to each.

show.title: style: size_range, point, trend_line
show.description:
`size_range: [min, max]` is the smallest and largest radius in canvas pixels (Chart.js
`radius`); `point` marks each center with a character; `trend_line: linear` fits a
dashed line through the centers.
